pages.title: Netherite Singularity
pages.text: Netherite crushed into a single point. It is dark and dense, already the heaviest metal I had, now heavier still. It does not burn and it does not scratch, and holding it feels unshakeable. Lava slides off it and it stays exactly the temperature it was.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Netherite is ancient debris and gold, already immensely tough. I fed what I had into the Singularity Compactor and it collapsed into a single, unbreakable point.
